mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, study_date, status FROM NC.study_streak_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY study_date
SELECT id, user_id, study_date, status FROM NC.study_streak_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND study_date = #{studyDate} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NC.study_streak_record (user_id, study_date, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{studyDate}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE NC.study_streak_protection SET protection_count = protection_count - 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND protection_count > 0
UPDATE NC.study_streak_protection SET protection_count = protection_count + #{amount}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
